info.name: GitHub Get Pre-receive Hook for an Organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: pre_receive_hook_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the pre-receive hook.

items.docs: This API endpoint retrieves detailed information about a specific pre-receive hook configured for a GitHub organization. By making a GET request to `/orgs/{org}/pre-receive-hooks/{pre_receive_hook_id}`, you can fetch the configuration and metadata of a particular pre-receive hook identified by its unique ID within the specified organization.
